court: In the High Court of Madras†
respondents: Muthukumarasamy, General Manager, Tamil Nadu State Transport Corporation (Kumbakonam) Limited … Contemnor/Respondent.
case_number: Cont. P(MD) No. 3249 of 2025 in W.P.(MD) No. 20175 of 2022
advocates: For Respondent : Mr. S.C. Herold Singh Standing Counsel
judgment_text:
Prayer : contempt petition is filed under Section 11 of the Contempt of Courts Act, to punish the respondent herein for his wilful disobedience of the order of this Court in W.P.(MD) No. 20175 of 2022, dated 1-7-2025

ORDER

The present contempt petition has been filed alleging violation of the orders of this Court dated 1-7-2025 made in W.P.(MD) No. 20175 of 2022.

2. Challenging the said order, the respondent/Transport Corporation has preferred Writ appeal in W.A.(MD) No. 109 of 2026, wherein the Hon'ble Division Bench of this Court was pleased to grant interim orders on 4-2-2026.

3. Recording the same, this contempt petition stands closed with liberty to the petitioner to revive the same, depending upon the outcome of the writ appeal. Statutory notice is recalled.
